segments.sn12.50:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati … pe …“na, bhikkhave, sutavato ariyasāvakassa evaṃ hoti –
segments.sn12.50:1.3: ‘kiṃ nu kho kismiṃ sati kiṃ hoti, kissuppādā kiṃ uppajjati?
segments.sn12.50:1.4: Kismiṃ sati saṅkhārā honti, kismiṃ sati viññāṇaṃ hoti, kismiṃ sati nāmarūpaṃ hoti, kismiṃ sati saḷāyatanaṃ hoti, kismiṃ sati phasso hoti, kismiṃ sati vedanā hoti, kismiṃ sati taṇhā hoti, kismiṃ sati upādānaṃ hoti, kismiṃ sati bhavo hoti, kismiṃ sati jāti hoti, kismiṃ sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hotī’”ti?
segments.sn12.50:2.1: “Atha kho, bhikkhave, sutavato ariyasāvakassa aparappaccayā ñāṇamevettha hoti –
segments.sn12.50:2.2: ‘imasmiṃ sati idaṃ hoti, imassuppādā idaṃ uppajjati.
segments.sn12.50:3.2: ‘kiṃ nu kho kismiṃ asati kiṃ na hoti, kissa nirodhā kiṃ nirujjhati?
segments.sn12.50:3.3: Kismiṃ asati saṅkhārā na honti, kismiṃ asati viññāṇaṃ na hoti, kismiṃ asati nāmarūpaṃ na hoti, kismiṃ asati saḷāyatanaṃ na hoti, kismiṃ asati phasso na hoti, kismiṃ asati vedanā na hoti, kismiṃ asati taṇhā na hoti … pe … upādānaṃ … bhavo … jāti … kismiṃ asati jarāmaraṇaṃ na hotī’”ti?
segments.sn12.50:4.1: “Atha kho, bhikkhave, sutavato ariyasāvakassa aparappaccayā ñāṇamevettha hoti –
segments.sn12.50:4.2: ‘imasmiṃ asati idaṃ na hoti, imassa nirodhā idaṃ nirujjhati.
segments.sn12.50:4.6: nāmarūpe asati saḷāyatanaṃ na hoti … pe … jātiyā asati jarāmaraṇaṃ na hotī’ti.
segments.sn12.50:5.1: “Yato kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako evaṃ lokassa samudayañca atthaṅgamañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako diṭṭhisampanno itipi, dassanasampanno itipi, āgato imaṃ saddhammaṃ itipi, passati imaṃ saddhammaṃ itipi, sekkhena ñāṇena samannāgato itipi, sekkhāya vijjāya samannāgato itipi, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno itipi, ariyo nibbedhikapañño itipi, amatadvāraṃ āhacca tiṭṭhati itipī”ti.
segments.sn12.50:6.1: Dve pañcaverabhayā vuttā, dukkhaṃ loko ca ñātikaṃ;
segments.sn12.50:6.5: Dve ariyasāvakā vuttā, vaggo tena pavuccatīti.

lines: Dvepi nayā ekato vuttāti idaṃ “viññāṇe sati nāmarūpaṃ hotī”tiādinā navame vuttassa nayassa “avijjāya sati saṅkhārā hontī”tiādinā dasame vuttanaye antogadhattā.
